name: VRM_PERF_OBLIGATIONS
description: This table contains the performance obligations of customer contract.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: NET_POSITION_COMPUTED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the net position is computed for the given performance obligation.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE_CLOSED
columns.description: Date on which the performance obligation is fully satisfied and fully billed.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Performance obligation number.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_TYPE
columns.description: Obligation type of a performance obligation. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_PERF_OBLIGATION_TYPE.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIG_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Classification code of a performance obligation. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_OBLIG_CLASSIF_CODE.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the performance obligation template that is used to group the source document lines under a single performance obligation.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_GROUP_RULE_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the performance obligation identification rule that is used to group the source document lines under a single performance obligation.

columns.name: PRICING_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Pricing combination identifier.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Revenue price line unique identifier.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_METHOD
columns.description: Specifies whether the obligation is satisfied at a point in time or over time. Values are derived from  the ORA_VRM_SATISFACTION_METHOD lookup type.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Satisfaction status of the performance obligation. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_SATISFACTN_STATUS.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the performance obligation is satisfied.

columns.name: OBLIG_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the obligation.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_NET_LINE_AMT
columns.description: Total line amount of all the performance obligation lines in the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_NET_SALES_PRICE
columns.description: Total net unit selling price in all the performance obligation lines in the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_TOT_VAR_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Variable consideration amount of all performance obligation lines in the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_TOT_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Total net consideration amount in all the performance obligation lines in the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_TOT_CARVE_OUT_AMT
columns.description: Total discount amount of all performance obligation lines in the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_TOT_ALLOC_AMT
columns.description: Total allocated transaction price in the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_TOTAL_RECOG_REV_AMT
columns.description: Total revenue recognized  for all the performance obligation lines in  the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_TOTAL_BILLED_AMT
columns.description: Total billed amount of all the performance obligation lines in the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Revenue price amount of the obligation in the obligation currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total payment amount for all the performance obligation lines in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_NET_LINE_AMT
columns.description: Total line amount of all the performance obligation lines in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TOT_VAR_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Variable consideration amount of all the performance obligation lines in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TOT_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Total net consideration amount of all the performance obligation lines in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TOT_CARVE_OUT_AMT
columns.description: Total discount amount of all the performance obligation lines in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TOT_ALLOC_AMT
columns.description: Total allocated transaction price in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TOTAL_RECOG_REV_AMT
columns.description: Total revenue recognized for all the performance obligation lines in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_TOTAL_BILLED_AMT
columns.description: Total billed amount of all the performance obligation lines in the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Revenue price amount of the obligation in the contract currency.

columns.name: LIST_PRICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: List price amount of an item.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Discount percentage.

columns.name: COST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cost amount.

columns.name: GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Gross margin percentage.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Base price percentage.

columns.name: EXEMPT_FROM_ALLOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation is exempted from allocation.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIG_FREEZE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the performance obligation is frozen.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: User entered comments.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for converting amounts from the obligation currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Conversion date to be used to derive the conversion rate for converting amounts from the obligation currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: DEVOLVE_PO_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation is devolved. A performance obligation is devolved if the Devolve performance obligation option is set to Yes in either the performance obligation identification rule or the implied obligation template that was used during identification of the performance obligations.

columns.name: INITIAL_PERF_EVT_EXPECTED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the initial performance event is expected to be created.

columns.name: INITIAL_PERF_EVT_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the initial performance accounting event was created.

columns.name: INITIAL_PERF_EVT_RECORDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the initial performance accounting event was recorded.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created..

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REMOVED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a given performance obligation is removed from customer contract.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.description: Legal entity of the performance obligation.

columns.description: Revenue price profile.

columns.description: Performance obligation processing unique identifier.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_DR_ASSET_AMT
columns.description: Total debit contract asset amount on the performance obligation.

columns.description: Total credit contract liability amount on the performance obligation.

columns.description: Total debit discount amount on the performance obligation.

columns.name: SUBSTANTIAL_DIST_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total discount amount in all the performance obligation lines in the obligation currency.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: IMPL_PERF_OBLIG_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the implied performance obligation template.

columns.name: DISCARD_FLAG
columns.description: Used to identify whether the obligation is discarded or not

columns.name: OBLIGATION_REFERENCE
columns.description: User entered performance obligation reference or grouping attribute values used to identify the performance obligation as derived by enabling the Copy to Reference option in the Performance Obligation Identification rule.

columns.name: FIRST_SATISFACTION_EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the first satisfaction event is created for a promised detail line under an obligation.

columns.name: LATEST_REVISION_INTENT_CODE
columns.description: Revision intent of the last promised detail revision of the performance obligation. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_REVISION_INTENT_TYPE.

columns.name: LATEST_VERSION_DATE
columns.description: Date of the most recent version of the performance obligation's underlying promised detail.

columns.name: RESIDUAL_APPROACH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the pricing for the goods or services is variable or missing and the standalone selling price for the performance obligation is estimated using the residual approach. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_RESIDUAL_PRICE_AMT
columns.description: Calculated residual estimated extended standalone selling price of the performance obligation in the contract currency.

columns.name: OBLIG_CUR_RESIDUAL_PRICE_AMT
columns.description: Calculated residual estimated extended standalone selling price of the performance obligation in the entered currency.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: The basis used to calculate the ratio of the allocated revenue for performance obligation distributions to their underlying promise detail lines. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOC_BASIS.

columns.name: ABS_SSP_PO
columns.description: The absolute value of the unit standalone selling price for an item or service.

columns.name: PO_SSP_RANGE_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule that is applied to the performance obligation template in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_RULE.

columns.name: PO_SSP_RULE_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: The result of the rule that is applied to the performance obligation template in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: SSP_LOW
columns.description: The low point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: SSP_HIGH
columns.description: The high point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: REFERENCE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency used as the reference currency for converting entered currency amounts to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type used to convert entered currency amounts to reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date used to convert entered currency amounts to reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Rate used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the reference currency.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_CURRENCY_UNIT_SSP
columns.description: The unit standalone selling price in obligation currency.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_EXISTENCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if one or more promised details of the performance obligation has any additional satisfaction events associated with it. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_ASE_EXISTANCE.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The overall fulfillment status of all the additional satisfaction events of all the promised detail lines related to the performance obligation. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_SATISFACTION_STATUS.

columns.name: FOREIGN_CURR_TREATMENT_CODE
columns.description: The currency conversion treatment used for contract liability accounting distributions when processing foreign currency performance obligations for the ledger. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_FX_CURR_TREATMENT.
